source.title: Belfast Telegraph, 20 May 1964, p. 4 ("Six years, is filled")
source.publisher: Belfast Telegraph (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: the Kilrea count read in the Coleraine Chronicle of 10 June 1964 and the nomination report in the Belfast Telegraph of 20 May 1964.

note: Triennial election of Coleraine Rural District Council, polled Thursday 4 June 1964. Only Kilrea was contested; Boveedy is the one other division whose new member is named in the reports read. The other eighteen members were returned unopposed but are not individually listed in the sources consulted. Ballylagan and Lislea added from the annual meeting of the new council (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed in the seat vacated by Mr. Samuel Warwick. Returned unopposed.
